android.deltachat.bot_evidence_device_lo.instruction: Create a new note in Markor titled "Bot unread summary" containing the text "Avatar and Sticker records" on the first line, followed by the text from the message containing "Unread Avatar expansion 04" in the Delta Chat conversation with "Avatar Bot" (located via the search query "android_avatar_unread_04") on a new line, and the text from the message containing "Unread Sticker expansion 04" in the Delta Chat conversation with "Sticker Bot" (located via the search query "android_sticker_unread_04") on a subsequent new line, with the note saved after each addition. In Delta Chat, establish a new group named "Bot Evidence Group" with the description "Avatar and Sticker evidence" and send the message "Bot evidence group ready" to it. Share the completed Markor note file to "Saved Messages" in Delta Chat and send it, then share the same Markor note file to the "Bot Evidence Group" and send it. Within the "Bot Evidence Group", send the message "Device evidence follows" followed by an attachment from the gallery of the photo showing a black phone on a gray repair bench with multiple cracks in the glass from the bottom upward, a metal precision screwdriver on the left, and a black USB-C cable on the right. Follow this with the message "Location evidence follows" and an attachment from the gallery of the photo showing a city street in the rain at dusk, with wet pavement reflecting orange shop lights and white car lights, a bicycle parked in front of a shop on the right, and vehicles passing in the distance. Conclude the sequence in the "Bot Evidence Group" by sending the message "Screen and location linked".

android.deltachat.delivery_claim_record_.instruction:
Create a new note in Markor titled "Delivery claim record" and populate it with the following content, preserving the exact line breaks, capitalization, and spelling: a heading line "# Delivery claim record", followed by "Case: Apartment delivery", a subheading "## Claim scope", "Carrier: Liam route", "APartment drop was delayed", "Replacement stock is limited", a subheading "## Evidence needed", "Reference number from Liam", "- Doorway condition", "- Package placement photo", "Delivery label is visible", "Empty shelf evidence", a subheading "## Resolution", "Send record to Liam", "Pending carrier response", "Await replacement approval", and finally "Owner: Liam claims". Save the note.

In Delta Chat, create a new group named "Claim Review Cell" with the description "Delivery stock evidence" and send the message "Claim review opened" to the group. Forward the message from Nora QA that includes "Image proof from Nora QA" into the group. The "Saved Messages" chat in Delta Chat must contain a sent message consisting of the exact text copied from the message from the contact "android_bob_unread_04" (Bob Ops) that includes "Unread Bob expansion 04". The "Claim Review Cell" group must also contain the text message "Two sources captured".

Append a new section to the end of the "Delivery claim record" note in Markor containing the following lines in order: "## Collected findings", "Finding owne: Claims desk", "Evidence set is completer", "- Parcel was near the mat", "Door photo received", "Nora image proof received", "Replacement review requested", "Next step: Carrier decision", and "Owner: Claims desk". Save the note. Share the "Delivery claim record.md" file as a file attachment to the "Claim Review Cell" group in Delta Chat. After the file is sent, send the text message "Claim record delivered" to the group.

In the "Claim Review Cell" group, attach and send a photo from the Gallery. The correct image is a bright living room scene featuring a sealed cardboard box on a light-colored rug in front of a beige sofa, with a dark coffee table and a small potted plant to the left, and a floor lamp, large green plant, and balcony glass doors visible in the background. The task is complete when the chat list is visible and the evidence has been associated in the group.

android.deltachat.mobility_safety_actual.instruction:
Create a new Delta Chat group named `Mobility Safety Cell` with the description `Bike car route decisions`, and immediately send the message `Safety review room opened` inside it. The group must also contain a forwarded copy of the second-to-last incoming white message from the conversation with Sofia that contains the text `route_pin_cedar_55_final`.

Create a new note in the Markor application titled `Mobility safety review`. The body of the note must contain the following lines in order, each on its own line: `# Mobility safety review`, ` Source lead: Sofia Maps`, ` ## Field route update`, ` Route_pin_cedar_55_final`, ` ## Route signal`, ` River path may be wet`, and ` Car warning needs review`. The note must be saved.

The `Mobility Safety Cell` group must contain the following sequence of messages and attachments: the message `River segment checked`; a photo from the gallery showing a city bicycle parked next to a riverside path with the water surface, a railing, and trees visible; the message `Cafe fallback image follows`; a photo from the gallery showing a wooden table by a window with a black cup of latte art coffee on each side, a white plate with powdered sugar pastries in the center, and a black hardcover notebook with black sunglasses in the foreground; the message `Two route signals logged`; a photo from the gallery showing a car dashboard from the driver's perspective with a yellow warning light illuminated next to the speedometer and the bottom edge of the steering wheel visible; a reply to that dashboard photo containing the message `Avoid this car today`; and the message `Cafe bike car evidence linked`.

Append the following lines to the end of the `Mobility safety review.md` file in Markor: `Image proof from Omar Design: icon polish review; visual_token=icon_pass_teal_314_image.`, `## Route Summary`, `Bike: Wet path`, and `**Cafe: Safe fallback**`. Save the note and share the file with the `Mobility Safety Cell` group in Delta Chat. The final state must be the Delta Chat chat list.

android.deltachat.release_control_room_1.instruction:
Create a new Delta Chat group named `Release Control Room` with the description `Launch evidence and owners`, and ensure the group contains the message `Release room is open` as its initial content.

The group must also contain a shared file from a Markor note titled `Release control pack`. The note body must contain the following lines in order, each separated by a Return: `# Release Control Pack`, `Incident lead: Core team`, `Owner: Release team`, `Window: Evening launch`, `## Source Signal`, and `Avatar alert copied`. Following these lines, the note must include the full text of the message containing `Unread Avatar expansion 04` from the contact `Avatar Bot` (identified by the search term `android_avatar_unread_04`), followed by a Return and the lines `## Launch Checklist`, `- Verify release window`, `- Confirm alert channel`, and `- Assign rollback owner`, each separated by a Return. The note must end with the text `Verify build and rollback` without a trailing Return.

Following the shared note file, the group must contain the message `Workspace baseline follows`. Subsequently, the photo from the gallery showing a sunlit office with a wooden desk, a silver laptop on the left displaying a blue-green statistical chart, an open paper notebook and pen in front, a grey coffee cup on the right, and a potted plant in the background must be sent, followed by the message `Planning board follows`. The photo from the gallery showing an empty meeting room with a long table holding scattered notebooks, pink and blue sticky notes, and three water bottles, a whiteboard on the right wall covered in multicolored sticky notes, and a large window on the left letting in daylight must then be sent, followed by the message `Delivery risk follows`. The photo from the gallery showing an office receiving desk with four sealed brown cardboard boxes stacked on the right side of the table, each with a blank white label, and a blue tape dispenser and clipboard in the bottom left corner must then be sent, followed by the message `Three baselines accepted`.

The message `Three baselines accepted` must be replied to with `Proceed with monitored launch`. The meeting room photo must be replied to with `Board owns launch sequence`. The Markdown release pack file must be replied to with `Pack binds the three photos`. The messages `Core team owns the window` and `Pack and photos delivered` must be sent in that order. The group must conclude with the photo from the gallery showing a black smartphone on a grey repair bench with multiple cracks in the glass extending upward from the bottom, a metal precision screwdriver on the left, and a black USB-C cable on the right.

android.deltachat.river_park_action_team.instruction:
Create a new group chat in Delta Chat named River Park Action Team with the description Site food volunteer relay, and populate it with a sequence of text messages, attached photos, a shared file, a forwarded image, and a reply that collectively document the site, catering, and volunteer signal status. The group must contain the text message Setup walk starts now followed by an attached photo from the gallery showing an outdoor event setup in a grassy park with folding tables and strings of colorful flags. The group must also contain the text message Catering proof follows followed by an attached photo from the gallery showing paper grocery bags on a wooden table with fresh vegetables, bread, and fruit visible at the top. The group must contain the text message Sample meal is approved followed by an attached photo from the gallery showing a complete meal set on a restaurant wooden table, featuring a white plate with a main dish and sides, accompanied by a drink. The group must contain the text message Food and site now aligned. The group must contain a reply to the previously sent photo of the grocery bags with the text Supplies cover final count. The group must conclude with the text message Runbook owners notified.

A note titled Community event runbook must exist in the Markor application with the following body content, where each line is separated by a return: # River Park Day, Site: East lawn, ## Site opening, Gate lead: River crew, Power lead: Stage B, 1. Check tents at 08:00, Test stage power, Mark the east gate, ## Communications update, Final headline copied from Zoe, [content of the bottom-most white incoming message from the contact found by searching for android_zoe_unread_11 containing the text headline_set_14_final], ## Volunteer signals, Signal lead: Stage B, Flags guide volunteers, - Green flag means stocked, Blue flag means ready, Red flag means pause, **Keep the east gate clear**, Keep food beside stage B, and Owner: Park crew. The content of the bottom-most white incoming message from the contact found by searching for android_zoe_unread_11 containing the text headline_set_14_final must be copied to the clipboard and pasted into the note immediately after the line Final headline copied from Zoe.

The saved note titled Community event runbook must be shared as a file to the River Park Action Team group in Delta Chat. The meal photo attached to the message Sample meal is approved in the River Park Action Team group must be forwarded to Saved Messages.

android.deltachat.training_handover_1787.instruction:
Create a new Markdown file in Markor titled `Training field handover` and a Delta Chat group named `Training Relay Team` that together deliver a complete training handover package. The saved Markor document must contain, in this exact order, a level-one heading `# Training Field Handover`, the lines `Edition: Field relay`, `Audience: field coaches`, and `Goal: Visible decisions`, a level-two heading `## Route Lesson` followed by the lines `Signal: Three way marker`, `Choose a path with evidence`, and `Keep the backpack visible`, a level-two heading `## Practice Station` followed by the lines `Use the canvas bag station` and `Prepare tools before work`, and a level-two heading `## Coach Notes` followed by the line `Coach: Mei Chen` and the bullet point `- Keep route choices visible`.

The Delta Chat group `Training Relay Team` must have the description `Route practice and handover` and contain the message `Training relay is ready` with an immediate reply to that specific message reading `Mei source anchors lesson`, followed in sequence by the messages `Manual delivery follows`, `Route and tools stay paired`, and `Three visuals will follow`. The group chat must also include the file `Training field handover.md` from the Markor folder in the Documents directory, followed by the message `Route image from Mei follows`, a photo from the gallery showing a green forest three-way path identifiable by three blank wooden signs on the left, a dark green backpack, and a blue water bottle, followed by the message `Practice image follows`, a second photo from the gallery showing a wooden workbench with an unfinished beige canvas bag in the center, fabric samples on the left, and a measuring tape with two black scissors on the right, followed by the message `Manual and images delivered`, and a third photo from the gallery showing an empty meeting room with a long table holding scattered notebooks, pink and blue sticky notes, and three water bottles, a whiteboard covered in multicolored sticky notes on the right, and a large window letting in daylight on the left.

A separate Delta Chat message `Training draft has started` must be sent to `Saved Messages`, and the chat with `Mei Chen` associated with the contact `android_mei_unread_04` must be opened.

android.deltachat.travel_recovery_human_.instruction:
In Delta Chat, deliver a travel recovery evidence package to the Saved Messages conversation and the new `Night Transfer Desk` group, and in Markor, author and share a `Travel recovery log` note that binds the rail, air, and hotel recovery records.

The Saved Messages conversation must contain a photo from the gallery showing a small table by a window with a train carriage speeding past green fields and distant mountains outside, immediately followed by the text message `Travel evidence opened`.

A new group named `Night Transfer Desk` with the description `Rail air hotel recovery` must exist in Delta Chat. Within this group, the message `Recovery desk is now live` must be sent, followed by two photos from the gallery: first, a photo of a dark suitcase leaning against a seat in an airport waiting area with a glowing flight information screen in the distance, and second, a photo of a tidy hotel room featuring a double bed with white sheets, a bedside lamp, and curtains all visible in the frame. After both images are sent, the text message `Train airport hotel linked` must be sent.

The message `Mei update 02: arrival window is 17:40 to 17:55, owner is Mei.` from the conversation with the contact `android_mei_unread_04` must be forwarded to the `Night Transfer Desk` group.

A new note titled `Travel recovery log` must be created in Markor with the following content exactly, ensuring each line is separated by a return:
`# Travel recovery log`
`Desk: Night transfer`
`## Rail update`
`Train evidence is stored`
`Miles Q`
`A medium note 02: `
`notification sweep #28; `
`token=notif_matrix_62; `
`follow-up is captured.`
`## Transfer risks`
`Airport seats need review`
`Weather may delay transfer`
`- Bus capacity is pending`
`Last train may be missed`
`Hotel hold expires at 22:00`
`## Decision`
`Use bus if train is missed`
`Hold rooms until 22:00`
`Keep airport fallback open`
`Owner: Night desk`
`**Status: Recovery active**`

The saved `Travel recovery log` note must be shared as a file to the `Night Transfer Desk` group in Delta Chat. In the `Night Transfer Desk` group, a reply to the sent `Travel recovery log` file must contain the text `Log binds rail air hotel`, followed by a new message with the text `Recovery log is final`. The group must also contain a photo from the gallery depicting a city street in the rain during the evening, where the wet pavement reflects orange shop lights and white car headlights, multiple bicycles are parked in front of a shop on the right, and vehicles are visible in the distance.

android.opendriver.driver_workspace_supp.instruction: Sign in to the OpenDriver application using the name Dana Driver, the email address dash@example.com, and the password password123 to access the Driver Workspace. The Work tab must display the Review requests section with the Open queue active, and the map view must reflect interactions including zooming in, zooming out, selecting the Service city, and activating My location, with the page view adjusted to reveal the Vehicle area before returning to the request cards area. The Work page must be refreshed, the Review requests and Open queue sections re-entered, and the map zoom in and zoom out actions performed again. The Account tab must show the driver status set to Go online, with the page reflecting the online state, and one request must be opened with the Service city selected on the map. The status must then be set to Go offline and immediately back to Go online. The Account page view must display the Driver onboarding form with input fields interacted for the D-2048 driver license, Toyota vehicle make, Camry vehicle model, 2022 year, DRV-204 license plate, and Blue color, with the keyboard dismissed and the view returned to the Availability area. The Money tab must be selected and refreshed, with the view adjusted to reveal the Payouts area before returning to the Today and Total cards, and then adjusted again to make the Trip earnings and Available payout information visible before returning to the top of the income summary, followed by another refresh of the Money page. The Support tab must show the customer support message input field interacted with and the keyboard dismissed, a new support ticket created, and the list refreshed to ensure the new ticket is displayed. The Support page view must be adjusted to make the newly appearing rider issue - open ticket visible, with Reply to ticket selected within the rider issue - open ticket and the view returned to the support list area, followed by Reply to ticket selected within the Payments - open ticket and the view returned to the support list area again. The Support page view must be returned to the Driver safety and support top, the customer support message input field interacted with, and the keyboard dismissed. The Support page must be refreshed, and the final view must be the support ticket list page where the rider issue - open ticket is visible.

android.opendriver.rider_full_service_lo.instruction: Sign in to the OpenDriver application using the Rider role with the name Avery, the email address rider@example.com, and the password password123, and complete a full service cycle ending with a logged-out state. The first ride request must use the current location as the pickup point and University Avenue, Palo Alto, CA as the destination, with pins adjusted as needed, the destination saved, and the ride requested for immediate departure. Once the first ride is active, save the invoice as a PDF, rate the trip, and book a second ride. The second ride must have University Avenue, Palo Alto, CA as the destination, with the pickup and destination locations swapped and a stop added. The ride history must display the first University Avenue, Palo Alto, CA trip record, and both the scheduled and completed ride cards must be checked. The active ride view must have the invoice PDF saved again, and the receipt in the history section must be accessed. In the safety section, the trip must be shared, emergency help must be requested, and the ride PIN must be entered. A support ticket must be created by selecting the safety concern category and entering the message Need ride help, followed by a reply to the ticket. The open tickets for Payments and rider issue in the safety section must be reviewed. In the account section, the profile must be edited, and the wallet, coupons, notifications, and saved places must be accessed. In the ride section, the no payment option must be selected, and the ride must be requested for now. The ride, history, and account sections must be refreshed, and the application must be logged out.

android.opendriver.rider_three_scheduled.instruction:

The fourth image, a photo of a snow-capped mountain, forest, and lake, must be cropped to a width of 89 and a height of 72 preserving the sunset on the left, the snow peaks, and the lake reflection, have its HSL Yellow channel reduced to -8 to lower the intensity of the golden sunset and Green channel reduced to -10 to prevent the high-saturation forest from overpowering the snow peaks, have its Contrast reduced to -6 and Saturation reduced to -12 in the basic Edit adjustments to retain cloud and lake highlight details and correct the overly strong overall color, and be saved as the mountain lake brand landscape cover.

The third export is the experimental image featuring a white outline on the right side, which must have a Brightness value of -18 and a Contrast value of -10 in the Edit category, the Night filter applied in the Filters category, and a Width of 57 and Height of 100 in the Crop category. The fourth export is the split photo of two men in suits talking against a yellow and pink background, which must have a Contrast value of 8 and a Saturation value of -8 in the Edit category, and a Width of 68 and Height of 88 in the Crop category. All four images must be saved as separate exports upon completion.

ios.openshop.beauty_office_checkout_revi.instruction: Sign in to the OpenShop app with the account for Lucas Lin and the password “spring2026” to place two distinct orders and submit a review for the first. ios.openshop.coffee_baby_dual_checkout_9.instruction: Sign in to the OpenShop app with the account for Lucas Lin and the password “spring2026”, then complete two distinct checkout transactions and submit two product reviews. ios.openshop.home_four_item_cart_checkou.instruction:

ios.opentrip.nr2269_sanya_seabreeze_book.instruction: Create a flight booking and a hotel booking in OpenTrip for the specified travelers and dates. ios.opentrip.sanya_parkline_review_mj215.instruction:

ios.opentrip.sc2306_grand_axis_booking_2.instruction: Create a confirmed flight booking and a confirmed hotel booking in the OpenTrip application. The flight booking must be for Lucas Lin on Silver Comet flight SC2306, a direct flight from Shanghai (SHA) to Sanya (SYX) on 2026-06-12 in Economy class, sorted by Recommended, using the traveler profile “Lucas Lin · ID Card”, including the extra baggage option “Add 32kg checked bag / $96”, the contact phone number “13900002020”, the payment method “Alipay · Fast mobile payment”, and the note “Direct trip”. ios.opentwitter.accessibility_audit_enga.instruction: Complete the accessibility audit engagement in OpenTwitter while signed in as alex. ios.opentwitter.incident_engagement_prof.instruction: Mark all notifications as read and complete the incident engagement workflow on the Home feed by saving, reposting, and liking the post by Devon Brooks whose body begins with "Post-incident", then replying to it with the exact text "incident owner". Save, like, and repost the post titled "Support inbox triage" and reply to it with the exact text "owner path clear". ios.opentwitter.transit_signal_engagemen.instruction: Ensure the "City transit dashboards" post within the Civic Tech results for the "Transit dashboards" trend is saved, reposted, and replied to with the exact text "city signal clear". The "Civic Tech handoff" post by Felix Jones within the same Civic Tech results must be saved.

linux.blender.5_3_product_stage_layout.instruction: Open `product_stage.blend` in Blender, adjust the product-stage layout, and save the file in place at `/tmp/helloworld_blender_workspace/blender_5_3_product_stage_layout/product_stage.blend`. The object FeatureCube must have Location X 1.42, Y -0.84, Z 1.28, Rotation X 0, Y 14, Z -22, and Scale X 1.48, Y 0.78, Z 1.62. The object AccentCylinder must have Location X -1.72, Y 1.18, Z 0.92, Rotation X 0, Y 0, Z 26, and Scale X 0.48, Y 0.48, Z 1.84. The object HeroSphere must have Location X 2.36, Y 1.52, Z 1.14 and Scale X 0.74, Y 0.74, Z 0.74. The light FillLight must have Location X 1.45, Y -3.15, Z 6.35 and Rotation Z 32, keeping its other rotation values unchanged. The Camera must have Location X 7.4, Y -6.4, Z 5.2. In the timeline, the scene Start frame must be 12 and the End frame must be 96. All of these changes must be persisted by saving the file in place under the same name.

linux.blender.goal6_3_launch_card.instruction: Update the default stage scene that is open in Blender and save it as `g63_stage.blend` in the prepared workspace folder, so the file at `/tmp/helloworld_blender_workspace/blender_goal6_3_launch_card/g63_stage.blend` holds the final state. The default object Cube must have Location X -1.28, Y 0.64, Z 1.36, Rotation X 12, Y -8, Z 31, and Scale X 1.58, Y 0.72, Z 1.44. The Camera must have Location X 5.84, Y -6.72, Z 4.88 and Rotation X 57, Y -4, Z 39. The Light must have Location X -2.15, Y -3.35, Z 6.45 and Rotation X 48, Y 6, Z -21. A new mesh cube must be added and renamed Marker64, with Location X 1.92, Y -1.48, Z 0.54 and Scale X 0.46, Y 0.46, Z 0.82. The scene's start frame must be 18. Persist everything by saving with Save As under the file name `g63_stage.blend` in the current workspace directory.

linux.blender.pedestal_orbit_study.instruction: Starting from a fresh General scene in Blender, build a product pedestal study and save it to `/home/user/Desktop/Blender/00_task_history/blender_pedestal_orbit/pedestal_orbit_study.blend`. The default cube must be renamed PedestalBase, with Location Z 0.35 and Scale X 3.20, Y 2.40, Z 0.35, carrying a Bevel modifier with Amount 0.12 and Segments 4 and a new material named PedestalGraphite whose Base Color is dark gray (about RGB 0.08, 0.08, 0.08), Metallic 0.35, and Roughness 0.48. A mesh UV Sphere named HeroSphere must sit at Location Z 1.65 with Scale X/Y/Z 1.15, be shaded smooth, and use a new material named HeroBlue with a blue Base Color (about RGB 0.0, 0.22, 0.9), Metallic 0.70, and Roughness 0.26. A mesh Torus named OrbitRing must sit at Location Z 1.65 with Rotation X 72 degrees and Scale X/Y/Z 1.55, be shaded smooth, and use a new material named OrbitOrange with an orange Base Color (about RGB 1.0, 0.45, 0.05), Metallic 0.55, and Roughness 0.30. An Area light named ProductKeyLight must be placed at Location X 4.00, Y -3.00, Z 6.00 with Power 850. The Output properties must have Resolution X 1600, Resolution Y 1200, File Format PNG, and Output path `//renders/pedestal_study/`. Make HeroSphere the selected active object in the Outliner, then save the scene with Save As to the exact path above so the saved file keeps HeroSphere active.

linux.blender.product_gallery_review.instruction: In Blender, open `/tmp/helloworld_blender_workspace/blender_product_gallery/product_stage_seed.blend`, configure it as a product gallery review scene, and save it with Save As to `/tmp/helloworld_blender_workspace/blender_product_gallery/product_gallery_review.blend`. The render settings must use Render Engine Eevee with 96 render samples and Film Transparent enabled, and the Output properties must have Resolution X 1800, Resolution Y 1200, Resolution Percentage 100, File Format PNG, Color RGBA, and Output path `//renders/product_gallery/`. The Camera must have Lens 52 and Clip Start 0.10. RimLight must have Power 900 with a warm white color (about RGB 1.0, 0.86, 0.68), and FillLight must have Power 420 with a pale blue color (about RGB 0.55, 0.75, 1.0). FeatureCube must have Location X 1.05, Y -0.55, Z 1.45, Rotation Z -22, Scale X 1.45, Y 0.82, Z 1.75, and a warm red Base Color (about RGB 0.9, 0.28, 0.18). AccentCylinder must have Location X -1.95, Y 0.75, Z 0.95, Rotation Z 18, and a deep blue Base Color (about RGB 0.05, 0.12, 0.45). A new mesh Plane named GalleryTitlePlate must be at Location X -1.45, Y 2.72, Z 0.07 with Scale X 2.25, Y 0.22, Z 1.0 and a new material named TitlePlateBlue with a cyan blue Base Color (about RGB 0.0, 0.62, 0.85). A new mesh Cube named ReviewBlock must be at Location X -2.85, Y -1.75, Z 0.48 with Scale X 1.0, Y 1.0, Z 1.0 and a new material named ReviewGreen with a green Base Color (about RGB 0.12, 0.75, 0.28). Make ReviewBlock the selected active object in the Outliner, then save to the exact path above so the saved file keeps ReviewBlock active.

linux.blender.workspace_view_curve_text_.instruction: Working in the Blender scene that is already open, add and modify objects and save the result as `view_ops.blend` in the current working directory, so that `/tmp/helloworld_blender_workspace/blender_workspace_view_curve/view_ops.blend` contains the final scene. In the saved scene, the Camera and the Light must both be present and visible, having been hidden and then shown again in the Outliner. A Text object named Text must be added and then converted to a Mesh, so that it is stored as a mesh object. A Bezier curve named BezierCurve must be added and must remain a curve object, with its Geometry Bevel Depth changed from the default. A Plain Axes empty named Empty must be added, hidden with Hide Selected, and then made visible again, so that it is visible in the saved file. The Cube's Viewport Display color must be changed to a color clearly different from the default white, and the Cube must remain selected. The scene must contain exactly two mesh objects (Cube and Text), one curve, one empty, one camera, and one light. Save with Save As under the file name `view_ops.blend` without changing the save location, and keep Blender open on the saved scene.

linux.deltachat.bot_evidence_260901.instruction: Create a bot evidence summary document with a Linux text editor and use it together with two evidence photos to populate a new DeltaChat group. The plain-text file must be saved as `Bot unread summary.txt` in the `Documents` folder of the user's home directory, and its content must be, line by line: the title "Bot unread summary", then "Avatar and Sticker records", then the full text copied from the DeltaChat message containing "Unread Avatar expansion 04" in the chat with `Avatar Bot` (found by searching for `avatar_unread_04`), and then the full text copied from the message containing "Unread Sticker expansion 04" in the chat with `Sticker Bot` (found by searching for `sticker_unread_04`). In DeltaChat, a new group named "Bot Evidence Group" with the description "Avatar and Sticker evidence" must contain, in this order: the message "Bot evidence group ready"; the file attachment `Bot unread summary.txt` from `Documents`; the message "Device evidence follows"; the image `cracked_phone_repair_table.png` from `Pictures/deltachat_evidence_assets` (a black phone on a gray repair bench with glass cracked from the bottom upward, a metal precision screwdriver on the left, and a black USB-C cable on the right); the message "Location evidence follows"; the image `rainy_city_street_lights.png` from the same folder (a rainy city street at dusk with wet pavement reflecting orange shop lights and white car lights, a bicycle parked in front of a shop on the right, and vehicles in the distance); and finally the message "Screen and location linked". End with the `Bot Evidence Group` chat open in DeltaChat and do not log out.

linux.deltachat.customer_cell_260901.instruction: Build and then archive a customer evidence group in DeltaChat, backed by an investigation document written in a Linux text editor. A new DeltaChat group named "Customer Evidence Cell" with the description "Leak package investigation" must contain the message "Investigation room opened", followed by the image `sink_cabinet_leak.png` from `Pictures/deltachat_evidence_assets` (an open white sink cabinet with water dripping from the central white drain joint into a light blue plastic basin directly below, the rest of the cabinet mostly empty), and a reply to that leak image reading "Leak seen before shipment". The group must also contain a forwarded copy of the message containing "Unread Bob expansion 04" from `Bob Ops` (found by searching for `bob_unread_04`). A Markdown file saved as `Customer investigation.md` in the `Documents` folder of the user's home directory must contain these lines in order: "# Customer Investigation", "Case: Leak and package", the full text copied from the `Miles QA` message containing `notif_matrix_62` (found by searching for `notif_matrix_62`), "## Physical Evidence", "Source: Miles QA signal", "Signal ties case to shipment", "- Water reached cabinet", "Leak preceded delivery", "Box corner was crushed", "## Decision", "Escalation needs two images", "Archive after delivery", "Owner: Bob Ops", "**Reviewer: Miles QA**", and "Status: evidence complete". After that, the group must receive the image `warehouse_crushed_box.png` from `Pictures/deltachat_evidence_assets` (metal warehouse shelves with blue, yellow, and black sorting bins, a kraft cardboard box on the right with a visibly crushed upper-right corner, and a black pen lying on a clipboard in front), then the file attachment `Customer investigation.md` from `Documents`, then the message "Report and evidence complete", and that last message must also be forwarded to `Saved Messages`. Finally, archive the `Customer Evidence Cell` chat and end on the DeltaChat chat list with the group archived, without logging out.

linux.deltachat.release_room_260901.instruction: Set up a release control group in DeltaChat and deliver a Markdown release pack plus four evidence photos to it. A new group named "Release Control Room" with the description "Launch evidence and owners" must start with the message "Release room is open". A Markdown file saved as `Release control pack.md` in the `Documents` folder of the user's home directory, written in a Linux text editor, must contain these lines in order: "# Release Control Pack", "Incident lead: Core team", "Owner: Release team", "Window: Evening launch", "## Source Signal", "Avatar alert copied", the full text copied from the message containing "Unread Avatar expansion 04" in the chat with `Avatar Bot` (found by searching for `avatar_unread_04`), "## Launch Checklist", "- Verify release window", "- Confirm alert channel", "- Assign rollback owner", and "Verify build and rollback". After the opening message, the group must contain, in this order: the file attachment `Release control pack.md` from `Documents`; the message "Workspace baseline follows"; the image `office_dashboard_desk.png` from `Pictures/deltachat_evidence_assets` (a sunlit office wooden desk with a silver laptop on the left showing a blue-green statistics chart, an open paper notebook and pen in front, a gray coffee cup on the right, and a potted plant behind); the message "Planning board follows"; the image `meeting_room_planning_board.png` (an empty meeting room whose long table holds scattered notebooks, pink and blue sticky notes, and three water bottles, with a whiteboard covered in multicolored sticky notes on the right wall and a large window on the left); the message "Delivery risk follows"; the image `shipment_boxes_labels.png` (an office receiving desk with four sealed kraft boxes stacked on the right, each with a blank white label, and a blue tape dispenser and clipboard in the lower-left corner); and the message "Three baselines accepted". Then the group must contain a reply to "Three baselines accepted" reading "Proceed with monitored launch", a reply to the meeting room image reading "Board owns launch sequence", a reply to the `Release control pack.md` attachment reading "Pack binds the three photos", the messages "Core team owns the window" and "Pack and photos delivered" in that order, and finally the image `cracked_phone_repair_table.png` from `Pictures/deltachat_evidence_assets` (a black phone on a gray repair bench with glass cracked from the bottom upward, a metal precision screwdriver on the left, and a black USB-C cable on the right). End with the `Release Control Room` chat open in DeltaChat and do not log out.

linux.deltachat.training_relay_260901.instruction: Prepare a training handover document in a Linux text editor and deliver it with three images to a new DeltaChat group, recording a draft marker in Saved Messages along the way. The Markdown file must be saved as `Training field handover.md` in the `Documents` folder of the user's home directory and contain these lines in order: "# Training Field Handover", "Edition: Field relay", "Audience: field coaches", "Goal: Visible decisions", "## Route Lesson", "Signal: Three way marker", "Choose a path with evidence", "Keep the backpack visible", "## Practice Station", "Use the canvas bag station", "Prepare tools before work", "## Coach Notes", "Coach: Mei Chen", and "- Keep route choices visible". While the document is being drafted (after "Prepare tools before work" and before the Coach Notes section), the message "Training draft has started" must be sent to `Saved Messages` in DeltaChat. The `Mei Chen` chat, found by searching for `mei_unread_04`, must be opened to confirm the unread source message from Mei Chen exists. A new group named "Training Relay Team" with the description "Route practice and handover" must contain, in this order: the message "Training relay is ready"; a reply to that message reading "Mei source anchors lesson"; the messages "Manual delivery follows", "Route and tools stay paired", and "Three visuals will follow"; the file attachment `Training field handover.md` from `Documents`; the message "Route image from Mei follows"; the image `forest_three_way_route.png` from `Pictures/deltachat_evidence_assets` (a green forest three-way path with three blank wooden signs on the left, a dark green backpack, and a blue water bottle); the message "Practice image follows"; the image `canvas_bag_workbench.png` (a wooden workbench with an unfinished beige canvas bag in the center, fabric samples on the left, and a measuring tape and two black scissors on the right); the message "Manual and images delivered"; and the image `meeting_room_planning_board.png` (an empty meeting room with a long table holding scattered notebooks, pink and blue sticky notes, and three water bottles, a whiteboard covered in multicolored sticky notes on the right, and a large window letting in daylight on the left). End with the `Training Relay Team` chat open in DeltaChat and do not log out.

linux.drawio.incident_response_board_69_.instruction: Using the app.diagrams.net draw.io editor that is already open in Chrome, create an Incident Response Board diagram on the blank canvas and save it as `incident_response_board.drawio`. At the top there must be a widened rounded-rectangle title box reading "Incident Response Board" with bold text that is larger than the text in the other shapes. Beneath it, arrange four rows of three shapes each, laid out neatly without overlapping: the first row holds plain rectangles "Alert Received", "Initial Triage", and "Severity Checked" (left to right, roughly horizontally aligned); the second row holds a diamond "Customer Impact?" on the left, a rectangle "Incident Lead Named" in the middle, and a rectangle "Status Page Drafted" on the right; the third row holds a rectangle "Rollback Prepared" on the left, a diamond "Mitigation Working?" in the middle-left, and a rectangle "Fix Validated" on the right; and the fourth row holds note-style or callout shapes "Comms Sent", "Exec Updated", and "Postmortem Planned" from left to right. Each row must use one uniform light fill color: light blue (or another uniform light color) for the first row, light green for the second, light yellow for the third, and light orange for the fourth, each distinct per row. Below all of these, a wide status box must read "Overall Status: contained" in bold, wide enough for the text to be fully visible and positioned as the lowest element on the canvas. All labels must be spelled exactly as given, and no default placeholder texts such as "Process", "Text", "Label", or "Untitled Diagram" may remain in the saved file. Save the diagram under the file name `incident_response_board.drawio` so that it ends up in the Downloads, Documents, or Desktop folder; throughout, keep the browser window maximized at roughly 100% zoom, do not close Chrome, refresh the page, switch to another browser tab, or open any other draw.io file, and finish on the saved Incident Response Board page in draw.io.

linux.drawio.team_workspace_map_68_steps.instruction: Using the app.diagrams.net draw.io editor that is already open in Chrome, create a Team Workspace Map office seating diagram on the blank grid canvas and save it as `team_workspace_map.drawio`. A large rectangle occupying most of the middle of the canvas must serve as the office outline, labeled "Team Workspace Map", with no fill or a very light gray fill and a border slightly more prominent than ordinary shapes. Inside the outline, nine small rectangles labeled "Desk A1", "Desk A2", "Desk A3" (top row), "Desk B1", "Desk B2", "Desk B3" (middle row), and "Desk C1", "Desk C2", "Desk C3" (bottom row) must form a neatly aligned grid of three rows and three columns, all filled light blue. Also inside the outline, a circle labeled "Focus Room" sized so its text is fully visible must sit in the upper-right corner with a light green fill, a diamond labeled "Meeting Point" must sit on the right-middle side to the right of the desks with a light yellow fill, and a cloud or rounded shape labeled "Coffee Area" must sit in the lower-right corner with a light orange fill, without covering any other shape. Just outside the bottom of the office outline, a text box must read "Capacity: 9 desks + 3 shared zones". All text must be fully visible and uncropped, every shape except the capacity note must lie within the office outline, and no default placeholder labels such as "Text" or "Label" may remain. Save the diagram under the file name `team_workspace_map.drawio` so that it ends up in the Downloads, Documents, or Desktop folder; keep the Chrome window maximized, do not close the browser, refresh the page, switch tabs, or open other draw.io files, and finish on the completed seating diagram page in draw.io.

linux.drawio.webpage_launch_workflow_65_.instruction: Using the app.diagrams.net draw.io editor that is already open in the current Chrome window, build a Webpage Launch Workflow flowchart on the blank grid canvas and save it as `webpage_launch_workflow.drawio`. The diagram must have a title rectangle labeled "Webpage Launch Workflow" placed above the rest of the workflow and sized so the whole title is visible. Below it, the first row must contain three rounded-rectangle process steps aligned horizontally from left to right: "Draft Homepage Copy", "Review Navigation", and "Build Feature Sections". A second row beneath it must contain, from left to right, "Update Footer Links", "Check Analytics Tags", and "Add Signup CTA", with "Add Signup CTA" sitting below "Build Feature Sections". Below the second row near the center there must be a diamond decision shape labeled "QA Approved?" (sized so the label is fully visible), with a rounded rectangle labeled "Publish Website" at the bottom center of the workflow and a plain rectangle labeled "Fix Issues" to the left of the diamond. Arrow connectors must link Draft Homepage Copy to Review Navigation, Review Navigation to Build Feature Sections, Build Feature Sections to Add Signup CTA, Add Signup CTA to Check Analytics Tags, Check Analytics Tags to Update Footer Links, Update Footer Links to QA Approved?, QA Approved? to Publish Website (with the connector labeled "Yes"), QA Approved? to Fix Issues (with the connector labeled "No"), and Fix Issues back to Check Analytics Tags. The finished diagram therefore has the top title, eight main process nodes, and one decision diamond, with a clear layout, readable labels, and no leftover default placeholder labels such as "Text" or "Label". Save the diagram under the file name `webpage_launch_workflow.drawio` so that it ends up in the Downloads, Documents, or Desktop folder, do not close Chrome, do not use the browser toolbar's Finish update button, and leave the completed draw.io canvas open in Chrome.

linux.openblender.kiosk_arc_animation.instruction: Open the OpenBlender application in Chrome from the snap_2 desktop environment and load the project file kiosk_scene_v03_lighting.blend from the Recent Files list, then modify the scene objects and render settings within the Animation workspace. The object Animated_Cup_Arc must have its Location X set to 0.42, Location Y to -0.42, and Location Z to 1.42, with its Rotation Z set to -6, and a keyframe for Location and Rotation must be inserted on this object with the timeline positioned at frame 90. The object Neon_Menu_Sign must have its Rotation Z set to 5, and a duplicate of this object must exist in the scene named MenuGlowA with Location X set to 0.52, Location Y set to 0.22, Location Z set to 1.60, Scale X set to 1.06, Scale Y set to 1.06, and the material Warm Plastic assigned. A new cube object named ArcMarker must be added to the scene with Location X set to -0.75, Location Y set to 0.40, Location Z set to 0.35, Rotation Z set to 12, Scale X set to 0.28, Scale Y set to 0.28, and Scale Z set to 0.22, with a Bevel modifier applied featuring an Amount of 0.05 and Segments set to 3, and the material Matte Rubber assigned. The object Steam_Path_Preview must have its Rotation Z set to 8, Scale X set to 1.10, and Scale Y set to 1.10. linux.openblender.packaging_client_revie.instruction:
Configure the OpenBlender project packaging_concept_v03_client_review.blend so that the Recycled_Box_Blockout, Folded_Top_Flap, and Logo_Label_Redline objects carry the specified transforms, materials, and modifiers, a new Client_Approval_Badge object exists with its own transform and material, and the render, output, and layer settings match the client review requirements, with all changes persisted in the saved scene.

The Recycled_Box_Blockout object must have its Location set to X 0.08, Y 0.02, and Z 0.96, its Rotation Z set to -4, and its Scale set to X 1.08, Y 0.86, and Z 1.18. A duplicated material for this object must have its Roughness set to 0.68 and Metallic set to 0.04, and a Bevel modifier must be added with Amount 0.05 and Segments 3.

The Folded_Top_Flap object must have its Location Y set to -0.30 and Location Z set to 2.02, its Rotation X set to 22, and its Scale X set to 1.06. The material Orange Clay must be assigned to this object, and that material’s Roughness must be set to 0.58.

The Logo_Label_Redline object must have its Location Y set to -0.86 and Location Z set to 1.14, and its Scale set to X 0.78 and Y 0.38. A duplicated material for this object must have its Base Color set to a dark blue, its Roughness set to 0.24, and its Metallic set to 0.72, and a Solidify modifier must be added with Thickness 0.03.

A duplicate of Logo_Label_Redline must exist and be renamed Client_Approval_Badge. This new object must have its Location set to X 0.82, Y -0.88, and Z 1.48, its Scale set to X 0.30 and Y 0.16, and its Rotation Z set to 8. The material Blue Coated Metal must be assigned to Client_Approval_Badge.

The render configuration must have the Engine set to Eevee Next, Resolution set to 1600 x 1600, Samples set to 160, and FPS set to 24. The output configuration must have the Path set to //renders/packaging_client_review, File Format set to PNG, Color set to RGBA, and Compression set to 18. Ambient Occlusion must be enabled in the layer settings. The project must be saved so that all object, material, modifier, render, output, and layer changes are persisted in the packaging client review scene.

linux.openblender.robot_pose_review.instruction:

The IK_Target_Control object must have its Location set to X 1.55, Y -0.25, and Z 2.28, and its Scale set to X 0.24, Y 0.24, and Z 0.24, with a keyframe inserted at frame 64 to record this initial pose. The timeline must be set to frame 96, and the IK_Target_Control Location must be updated to X 1.30, Y 0.20, and Z 1.95, with a keyframe inserted to save this second pose.

The Upper_Arm_IK_Link object must have its Rotation Z set to -24, Location X set to 0.20, and Location Z set to 1.05, with a keyframe inserted at frame 96. The Forearm_IK_Link object must have its Rotation Z set to -62, Location X set to 0.88, and Location Z set to 1.82, with a keyframe inserted at frame 96. The Gripper_Pose_Snapshot object must have its Location set to X 1.54, Y 0.18, and Z 1.86, Rotation Z set to 12, and Scale X and Y set to 0.30, with a keyframe inserted at frame 96. For the Gripper_Pose_Snapshot, the material Preview Glass must be assigned, and the material properties must be adjusted so that Roughness is 0.12 and Metallic is 0.10.

The Robot_Base_Rotation object must have its Rotation Z set to 6, Scale X set to 0.86, and Scale Y set to 0.86, with a keyframe inserted at frame 96. A duplicate of the IK_Target_Control object must be created, and the newly created copy must be renamed to Pose_Target_Review in the Scene Collection. The render output settings must be configured by setting the Engine to Workbench, Resolution to 1280 x 720, Samples to 64, and FPS to 24. The output Path must be set to //renders/robot_pose_review. OpenBlender is a web app: open it from the OpenBlender icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.opencode.sk2_hook_debug_commit.instruction:
In the OpenCode application, produce a committed and synced codebase with a completed debug session, a lint execution, and a Copilot explanation, leaving the interface in the Run and Debug view.

The debug session must be initiated using the Node: Run tests launch configuration, during which the Continue, Step, Restart, and Stop commands are executed in that specific order, and the Debug Console must be the active view upon completion of these actions. The file src/hooks/useForecast.js must be modified by inserting exactly one line containing the text // retry later immediately after the line that contains setState, and the file must be saved. In the Copilot Chat panel, the Explain feature must be used to send the exact message test hook. The file src/services/api.js must be located via the Search functionality for fetchForecast, and the value of API_DELAY must be changed from 340 to 300 while ensuring fetchForecast remains present in the file, followed by saving the changes. The command npm run lint must be executed in the OpenCode terminal. A second debug session must be started using the Launch Chrome against local app launch configuration, during which the Variables and Call Stack sections are interacted with, the Ports tab is opened, the Go Live feature is activated, and the Output panel is viewed. In the Source Control view, the changes for both useForecast.js and api.js must be inspected, committed with the exact message Tune hook debug, and a Sync must be performed. The final state must have OpenCode open and remaining in the Run and Debug view, with both files committed and the npm run lint command visible in the terminal history. OpenCode is a web app: open it from the OpenCode icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.opencode.sk2_trendcard_loading_lab.instruction: Modify the file src/components/TrendCard.jsx in the OpenCode environment so that the element with className="skeleton" has an aria-label attribute set exactly to "Loading" with no trailing space and includes the attribute role="status". Save the file and format the document. The integrated terminal must contain the execution of the command npm run lint, and a second execution of npm run lint must also be present. A search-and-replace operation must be performed on TrendCard.jsx where the text "Loading" is replaced with the text "Loading". The file src/components/TrendCard.jsx must be open in the Outline view, and the Copilot Chat feature must contain the sent prompt "tests for loading". In Source Control, the changes to src/components/TrendCard.jsx must be staged, committed with the message "Fix loading label", and the repository must be synced. At completion, the files package.json, RevenueDashboard.jsx, and TrendCard.jsx must be open in tabs, with TrendCard.jsx as the active file, and the Source Control view must be visible. OpenCode is a web app: open it from the OpenCode icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.opencode.tooling_notes_settings.instruction: Configure the OpenCode application by installing the Vite Tools and React Snippets extensions, updating the extension set, and adjusting the environment settings to use the Default Light theme, a font size of 16, and enabled Word Wrap, Minimap, Format On Save, and Auto Save. The notes folder within the webpage directory on the Ubuntu0 desktop must contain the file review-2026-04-30.md, which should be modified to append the lines "Tooling notes", "Vite helpers on", and "React snippets on" to the end of the document, each on its own new line, followed by saving the file and executing the Save File command via the command palette.
