linux.opendriver.rider_single_1_1.instruction:
Complete the OpenDriver rider account and ride workflow as Riley Rider using `rider@example.com` and `Password123!`, leaving the Ride page active. Review the Account Wallet with Visa ending in 4242 selected, the Coupons panel, and the Saved places panel with Home selected, closing those panels after each review. The initial Green ride should go to Downtown Palo Alto, CA with Visa ending in 4242 as payment and `COMMUTE15` applied; add Stanford Shopping Center as a stop after the ride becomes active and save its invoice PDF from the active trip's receipt area.

Use the initial ride's `Book another ride` option to request a RideX trip to Stanford Shopping Center with Visa ending in 4242 and the Now departure choice. When the cancellation dialog appears for this second ride, keep the ride rather than confirming cancellation. In History, review the most recent Downtown Palo Alto trip and save its invoice PDF again from the historical receipt. Leave the Ride page active after a final review of the Account Coupons panel, with the rider session still signed in.

linux.openfinance.10_1.instruction: Configure the OpenFinance application to conclude with the Reports page visible, incorporating a new transaction, updated budget and goal settings, modified account and bill states, and a new portfolio holding. The Overview page must display the Last 90 days reporting period with the chart segmented to Cash flow. A new transaction must exist in the Transactions list with the date 2026-06-30, payee QA Coffee, type Expense, amount 14.56, account Everyday Checking, category Dining, the Cleared checkbox selected, and the note updated memo, having been initially created with an amount of 12.34 and the note receipt audit. The Budgets page must reflect the original month with the Housing budget amount set to 2250 and the Dining row filled, alongside a new goal named QA Reserve with a target amount of 900. The Accounts page must show the High Yield Savings account register with the Hide reconciled control active, where the new transaction row has its C status button toggled to change its cleared state and its R status button toggled to change its reconciled state. The Schedules page must show the Peak Fitness row skipped and the Northwind Payroll row posted now. The Bills page must display the Fiberlane Internet bill amount as 84 and the Travel Rewards Card bill card in a paid state. The Payees page must show the Brightline Energy entry with the Favorite button activated in the details area. The Rules page must have Apply to existing pressed at the top and the market rule run. The Portfolio page must include a new holding with the ticker symbol QAETF, 2 shares, and a current price of 101.

linux.openfinance.10_2.instruction: Configure the OpenFinance application so the Overview page displays the Last 90 days reporting period with a Cash flow chart, the Budget Health card is accessible, a new transaction for QA Coffee dated 2026-06-30 exists with an amount of 12.34, type Expense, account Everyday Checking, category Dining, Cleared status, and note receipt audit, and that same transaction is subsequently edited to an amount of 14.56 with the note updated memo. The Accounts page must show the Account Register set to High Yield Savings with the Hide reconciled control active, and the QA Coffee transaction row within that register must be toggled to cleared and then reconciled. The Budgets page must reflect the original month with the Housing budget amount set to 2250, the Fill control applied to the Dining row, and a new goal named QA Reserve with a target amount of 900. In the Schedules section, the Peak Fitness schedule must remain unposted while the Northwind Payroll schedule is posted immediately. The Bills page must show the Fiberlane Internet bill amount as 84 and the Travel Rewards Card bill marked as paid. The Payees section must have the Brightline Energy entry marked as a favorite. The Rules page must have rules applied to existing transactions and the market rule executed. The Portfolio section must include a new holding with the ticker symbol QAETF, 2 shares, and a current price of 101. The application must remain on the Reports page as the final state.

linux.openfinance.10_3.instruction: In the OpenFinance application, complete a series of account, transaction, bill, payee, rule, schedule, and budget updates. The Account Register area on the Accounts page must display the account type as Travel Rewards Card instead of High Yield Savings, with reconciled transactions hidden and the new transaction row in the account ledger showing a cleared C status and a reconciled R status. The Transactions page must contain a new saved transaction dated 2026-06-30 with payee QA Market, type Expense, amount 33.45, account Travel Rewards Card, category Groceries, cleared status checked, and note market audit; the transaction identified by the note market audit must have its category set to Groceries and its note changed to receipt fixed. The Bills page must show the Brightline Energy bill amount as 150 and marked as paid, the Evergreen Rent bill marked as paid, the Travel Rewards Card bill marked as paid, and the Fiberlane Internet bill amount as 86 and marked as paid. The Payees page must show the Whole Basket Market entry marked as a favorite and the Brightline Energy entry renamed to Brightline Power. The Rules page must include a new saved rule that matches transactions containing the text qamarket, assigns the payee QA Market, and assigns the category Groceries, with the rules applied to existing transactions and both the market rule and the energy rule run. The Schedules page must show the Peak Fitness scheduled transaction skipped and the Northwind Payroll scheduled transaction posted now. The Budgets page must display the original month with the Subscriptions budget line filled, the Groceries budget amount set to 540, the Transportation budget amount set to 310, and a new saved goal named QA Reserve with a target amount of 900 updating the goal list.

linux.openfood.qa02_s2_ops.instruction:
Update the merchant management settings in the OpenFood application to mark the restaurants Dumpling Room No. 20 San Jose CA, Santana Row Banh Mi Market No. 12 San Jose CA, and City Little Saigon Grill as closed, and set the availability of the following menu items to sold out: Pork Dumplings, Beef Chow Fun, and Mapo Tofu at Dumpling Room; Golden San Jose Pho Tai Rice, Golden San Jose Pho Tai Soup, and Golden San Jose Pho Tai Snack at Santana Row Banh Mi Market; and the two available items at City Little Saigon Grill.

Create a new order for Golden Curry Garden No. 35 San Jose CA containing one Pad Thai, two Green Curry Chicken, and two Drunken Noodles, applying the coupon code WELCOME12 before placing the order. Create a second new order for Pancake Social Aurora IL containing two items of the first available menu option and two items of the second available menu option, applying the coupon code WELCOME12 before placing the order.

Claim the voucher code SAVE15 in the Wallet section. Initiate a reorder from the existing order OF-2009 from Pita Market Downtown 39 Buffalo NY, ensuring the total quantity of items in the new cart is at least two, apply the SAVE15 coupon, and place the order. Advance the status of this newly created reorder twice.

Create a support ticket with the subject qa02, the Order ID OF-2009, and the message qa02 ops. The final view must be the Orders history page, and the persisted state must reflect the closed status of the specified restaurants, the sold-out status of the specified menu items, the claimed SAVE15 coupon, the three new orders with the correct coupon applications and quantity patterns, and the created support ticket.

linux.openfood.qa03_s2_ops.instruction:
Finalize the OpenFood application state by advancing courier and order statuses, executing two distinct restaurant checkouts, creating a support ticket, and claiming a wallet voucher.

In the Courier section, advance the delivery status for D-331 - Central La Jolla Poke No. 21 San Diego CA, D-332 - Old Town Pho House 37 - San Jose CA, D-333 - Station Queens Dumpling No. 33 New York City NY, and D-334 - Golden Sauce Station 26 Chicago IL by selecting the next step for each. For any delivery card currently marked as Needs courier, assign a courier and then select the next step for that same card. Later in the workflow, advance the status for D-331 - Central La Jolla Poke No. 21 San Diego CA by selecting the next step again, and conclude by selecting the Next step for the D-333 delivery card.

In the Admin section, update the status of the following orders: advance OF-2002 - Central La Jolla Poke No. 21 San Diego CA and OF-2004 - Old Town Pho House 37 - San Jose CA to Delivered; advance OF-2007 - Station Queens Dumpling No. 33 New York City NY to Out for delivery; advance OF-2013 - Old Town Riverwalk Bowls Naperville IL to Delivered; and advance OF-2015 - Pancake Social Arlington VA to Out for delivery. View the Imported complaint queue alert card.

In the Orders section, select Reorder on the OF-2001 - Smokehouse at Union 40 Arlington VA card. In the resulting cart, increase the quantity of the first item by one, select the WELCOME12 coupon code from the dropdown, and place the order. Ensure the most recently created or reordered records are visible.

Create a new support ticket with the subject qa03, the Order ID OF-2001, and the message qa03 route. Ensure the ticket is successfully created and visible in the list.

In the Wallet section, claim the voucher code WELCOME12.

In the Restaurants section, search for poke, set the Cuisine filter to All, and set the Sort option to Recommended. Locate the Central La Jolla Poke No. 21 San Diego CA restaurant, view its menu, and add the first two visible menu items to the cart. Increase the quantity of the first item in the cart by one.

In the Restaurants section, search for golden. Select the first restaurant result, view its menu, and add both Pad Thai and Green Curry Chicken to the cart. Apply a coupon code from the available options and place the order.

linux.openfood.qa04_snap2_deep_dish_stat.instruction:
In the OpenFood app, complete a series of orders, wallet claims, and support actions that conclude with the Restaurants section active, displaying the search term “pizza” and the Recommended sort setting.

The first order must be placed from the Dumpling Room No. 20 San Jose CA menu, containing Pork Dumplings, Beef Chow Fun, and Mapo Tofu, each with a quantity of 2, with the coupon WELCOME12 applied. The restaurant search state for “dumpling” must have the Cuisine filter set to All and the Sort option set to Recommended.

A second order must be created by reordering the most recent order from the Orders section, with the resulting cart modified so that the first item has a quantity of 3, the second item has a quantity of 1, and the third item has a quantity of 2, with the coupon WELCOME12 applied.

A third order must be created by reordering the specific order OF-2001 - Smokehouse at Union 40 Arlington VA from the Orders section, with the quantity of the first item in the resulting cart increased by 1 and the coupon WELCOME12 applied.

A support ticket must be created with the subject “qa01”, the Order ID “OF-2001”, and the message “qa01 late”.

The voucher codes WELCOME12 and SAVE15 must both be claimed in the Wallet section.

A fourth order must be placed from the Deep Dish Works menu, containing Deep Dish Pizza with a quantity of 2 and Chicago Hot Dog with a quantity of 1, with the coupon SAVE15 applied. The restaurant search state for “pizza” must have the Sort option set to Recommended.

A fifth and final order must be created by reordering the most recent order from the Orders section, with the resulting cart modified so that the first item has a quantity of 3 and the second item has a quantity of 2, with the coupon SAVE15 applied. The status of the most recent order in the Orders section must be advanced twice prior to initiating this final reorder.

linux.openmail.contacts_receipt_review_w.instruction:
Produce a completed receipt review workflow in the OpenMail application consisting of a sent reply, a sent forward, a sent labeled and starred email, a discarded draft, and a final open message view.

The reply to the email titled "Receipt PDF for order 4268" from the contact Northline Market must contain the body text "Northline receipt is ready for review." The forward of the email "Platform reference image for RN-2041" from the contact Railway Northeast must be addressed to "receipts@northline.example.test" and contain the body text "Rail platform reference for the receipt review." The email to the contact RideShare must have the subject "RideShare receipt question", the priority set to Low, the Travel label applied, and the body text "Can you confirm the ride receipt for the travel folder? Please reply with the receipt number." This email must exist in the Sent folder, retain the Travel label, and be starred. A draft addressed to the contact Northline Market with the subject "Northline contact note" and the body "Contact card compose route verified for receipts." must be discarded so that it no longer exists in the Drafts folder. The interface must conclude on the detail page of the "Platform reference image for RN-2041" message from the contact Railway Northeast, with the search query "RN-2041" remaining in the search box. OpenMail is a web app: open it from the OpenMail icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.openmail.image_attachment_review_f.instruction:
Configure the OpenMail account profile with the display name Anonym Tester, the email address anonym-x2024@outlook.com, the option to add a signature to new messages enabled, and the signature text exactly Best, Anonym Tester.

The email with the subject Desk setup image for expense notes, which contains an image attachment, must be marked as starred and assigned the Images label. A Reply all to this message must be sent with the body text The desk setup image is filed under Images.

A new email addressed to receipts@railne.example.test with the subject Image attachment review must be composed with the priority set to Low and the Images label assigned. The message body must include the sentence Please review the saved image evidence before the expense note is closed. and, after being saved as a draft and reopened, must have the sentence The signature settings were checked first. appended to the end of the existing body text before being sent.

The sent Image attachment review email must then be moved to the Trash and restored from the Trash to the Inbox, where the Follow up label is applied to it and it is marked as unread. The task is complete when the detail page for the Image attachment review email is visible, showing it as unread with the Follow up label and the full message body containing both required sentences. OpenMail is a web app: open it from the OpenMail icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.openmail.receipts_travel_archive_s.instruction:
In the OpenMail application, organize receipt and travel correspondence by applying labels, stars, and archive states to specific messages, and send a reply and a forward with exact body text.

The message from Northline Market in the Inbox, identified by the search term receipt with the Has attachments filter applied and results sorted by Sender, must carry the Receipts label and be marked as both Starred and Important. The Receipt PDF for order 4268 associated with this message must be moved to the Archive folder.

The message from Hotel Juniper Reservations, found by searching for hotel with the All messages filter, must be marked as unread and carry the Travel label. A reply sent from this message must contain the exact body text "The hotel itinerary is noted for travel review."

The message from Railway Northeast Desk, found by searching for platform rence, must be forwarded to receipts@rideshare.example.test with the exact body text "Sharing the platform reference for comparison." The resulting forwarded message in the Sent folder, identified by searching for platform reference, must carry the Travel label.

The message titled Platform reference image for RN-2041, found by searching for platform reference, must carry the Travel label, be marked as Starred, and be moved to the Archive folder. The final state must display this archived message open with the Archive and Travel labels visible and the starred state active.

linux.opennavigation.route_review_2_1.instruction: Execute a comprehensive multi-route navigation review within the OpenNavigation application consisting of seven distinct navigation sessions, each involving a specific destination, travel mode, and a complete Start, Overview, and End cycle. The first session must begin by selecting Meta Headquarters from the Recent list, initiating a Drive route from Current location with the current departure time, selecting the top route card, starting the navigation, accessing the voice icon located to the right of the Report button, viewing the Overview, and ending the navigation. The second session must select Googleplex from the Recent list, initiate a Walk route from Current location, open the Other time option to select Leave now, choose the first route card, start the navigation, view the Overview, and end the navigation. The third session must select Mountain View Transit Center from the Recent list, initiate a Bike route from Current location with the current departure time, select the top route card, start the navigation, view the Overview, and end the navigation. The fourth session must select Stanford University from the Saved list, initiate a Transit route from Current location with the current departure time, select the first route card, start the navigation, view the Overview, and end the navigation. The fifth session must select Meta Headquarters from the Recent list, initiate a Drive route, open the Other time option to select Leave now, select the first route card, start the navigation, view the Overview, and end the navigation. The sixth session must select Stanford University from the Saved list, initiate a Walk route, select the first route card, start the navigation, access the voice icon near the Report button, and end the navigation. A final seventh session must select Googleplex from the Recent list, initiate a Bike route, start the navigation, view the Overview, and end the navigation. Throughout the entire process, ensure that the trajectory includes at least sixty distinct interaction steps, explicitly utilizes the Route, Current location, Drive, Walk, Bike, and Transit controls, and strictly avoids selecting any Coffee Option or Hotels Option entries.

linux.opennavigation.route_review_2_2.instruction: Produce a completed multi-route navigation review in the OpenNavigation application consisting of seven distinct route previews across the Drive, Walk, Bike, and Transit modes. The review must include a Transit route from Current location to Stanford University (sourced from the Saved section) using the current departure time, where the first available transit route card is selected, the navigation is started, the voice icon to the right of the Report button is activated, the Overview panel is opened, and the navigation is ended. A Walk route from Current location to Mountain View Transit Center (sourced from the Recent section) using the current departure time must also be previewed by selecting the first walking route card, starting the navigation, opening the Overview panel, and ending the navigation. A Bike route from Current location to Googleplex (sourced from the Recent section) with the departure time set to Leave now via the Other time option must be previewed by selecting the top cycling route card, starting the navigation, opening the Overview panel, and ending the navigation. A Drive route from Current location to Meta Headquarters (sourced from the Recent section) using the current departure time must be previewed by selecting the first driving route card, starting the navigation, activating the voice icon to the right of the Report button, opening the Overview panel, and ending the navigation. A second Drive route from Current location to Stanford University (sourced from the Saved section) with the departure time set to Leave now via the Other time option must be previewed by selecting the first route card, starting the navigation, opening the Overview panel, and ending the navigation. A second Transit route from Current location to Mountain View Transit Center (sourced from the Recent section) must be previewed by selecting the first route card, starting the navigation, opening the Overview panel, and ending the navigation. A second Drive route from Current location to Meta Headquarters (sourced from the Recent section) must be previewed by selecting the first route card, starting the navigation, opening the Overview panel, and ending the navigation. The final state must reflect that at least three distinct Start, Overview, and End navigation cycles have been completed, all four travel modes have been utilized, and no interaction has occurred with Coffee Option or Hotels Option entries.

linux.opennavigation.route_review_2_3.instruction:
Execute a comprehensive multi-route navigation review in the OpenNavigation application by completing eight sequential navigation sessions for Stanford University, Meta Headquarters, Googleplex, and Mountain View Transit Center. Each session must result in an active navigation state where the route overview is displayed and the session is subsequently ended, with the interface consistently displaying the OpenNavigation identity and utilizing the Route controls, Start, Overview, and End functions.

The first session targets Stanford University from the Saved locations list, requiring the Walk travel mode and the first available walking route card. During this active navigation, the voice icon near the Report option must be interacted with before the Overview is viewed and the session is ended. The second session targets Meta Headquarters from the Recent locations list, requiring the Drive travel mode and the first available driving route card, with the Overview opened to review route details before ending the session. The third session targets Googleplex from the Recent locations list, requiring the Bike travel mode with the departure time configured via the Other time option to Leave now, and the top cycling route card selected. During this navigation, the voice icon near the Report option must be interacted with, the Overview opened, and the session ended. The fourth session targets Mountain View Transit Center from the Recent locations list, requiring the Transit travel mode and the first available transit route card, with the Overview opened to view the transit route summary before ending the session.

The fifth session returns to Stanford University from the Saved locations list, requiring the Bike travel mode and the first cycling route card, with the Overview opened before ending the session. The sixth session returns to Meta Headquarters from the Recent locations list, requiring the Walk travel mode and the first walking route card, with the Overview opened, the voice icon near the Report option interacted with, and the session ended. The seventh session returns to Googleplex from the Recent locations list, requiring the Drive travel mode and the first driving route card, with the Overview opened before ending the session. The eighth and final session returns to Mountain View Transit Center from the Recent locations list, requiring the Transit travel mode with the departure time configured via the Other time option to Leave now, and the first transit route card selected, with the Overview opened to view the route before ending the session. Throughout the entire process, no options related to Coffee Option or Hotels Option may be selected.

linux.opennote.bakery_resume_route_photo.instruction:
If OpenNote asks you to sign in, use the username lina and the password note2026. In the OpenNote application, establish a specific set of note interactions, publish a new entry, clear notifications, and update the user profile to reflect a specific role.

The note titled "Tiny adjustments that made tiny bakery line work", identified within the Food category by the search term "bakery", must be liked, saved to the collection, and commented on with the exact text "nice bakery find". The author Rowan Lee must be followed from their profile page. Similarly, the note titled "Home desk: resume line edit I would repeat", identified within the Work category by the search term "resume line edit", must be liked, saved, and commented on with the exact text "resume note saved", and the author Soda Kim must be followed from their profile page.

A new post titled "desk route log" must be created with the body text "lamp water 10min", categorized as Work, located at "home desk", and tagged with "work home". This post must use the "Use text cover" option and be published. The detail page for this "desk route log" note must be liked, saved, and commented on with the exact text "kept this setup".

The "My Saved" section must contain the notes "desk route log", "What changed after I tried three-shot sequence", and "Weekend-realistic caption timing for a normal day", each of which must have its detail page opened and then closed. All notifications in the Alerts section must be marked as read so that no unread indicators remain, and the specific notification for "Felix Sun liked your note" must be opened and then closed.

The user profile for Lina Park must be edited so that the Role field contains exactly "Desk route tester" and is saved. The final state must show the profile page displaying the name "Lina Park", the role "Desk route tester", and the note "desk route log".

linux.opennote.desk_cable_followup_snap2.instruction:
If OpenNote asks you to sign in, use the username lina and the password note2026. Open OpenNote from the Ubuntu desktop and execute a series of search, engagement, and publishing workflows. The final state must include three specific Home notes that are liked, saved, and commented on, two newly published notes with specific metadata and engagement, all alerts marked as read, and the final note left open in a specific state.

For the first engagement workflow, the note titled Desk cable cleanup after I found three mystery screws within the Home category must be liked, saved, and contain the comment Cable idea. For the second engagement workflow, the note titled Tiny adjustments that made open shelf edit work within the Home category must be liked, saved, contain the comment Shelf saved, and have the author June Ellis followed. For the third engagement workflow, the note titled Balcony watering after I underestimated how dusty the shelf was within the Home category must be liked, saved, and contain the comment Water check.

The first published note, titled Desk bay, must be a Home note with the body Cable tray note, the location Desk side, and the tags desk and plant. The text cover option must be enabled by selecting the rectangle to the left of Use text cover. This note must subsequently be liked, saved, and contain the comments Desk saved and Final save.

The second published note, titled Desk Cable Follow-up, must have the body Label the spare adapters, the location Desk side, and the tag desk. The text cover option must be enabled by selecting the rectangle to the left of Use text cover. On the resulting note detail page, the note must be saved and contain the comment Cable audit complete.

All alerts in the Alerts section must be marked as read. The final state of the application must show the personal profile with the Desk Cable Follow-up note open, displaying its saved state and comment.

linux.opennote.snap2_home_food_profile.instruction: If OpenNote asks you to sign in, use the username lina and the password note2026. In the OpenNote application, complete a workflow that results in specific notes being liked, saved, and commented upon, a user being followed, a new post being created, and profile details being updated. The note titled "Desk cable cleanup after I found three mystery screws" in the Explore section under the Home category must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Cable idea" added, with the #plant corner tag selected from that note. The note titled "Tiny adjustments that made open shelf edit work" must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Shelf saved" added. The author profile for June Ellis must be opened and followed, and from her profile, the note titled "Balcony watering after I underestimated how dusty the shelf was" must be saved, liked, and have the comment "Water check" added. The first visible note cover in the Following feed must be saved, and all notifications in the Alerts section must be marked as read. A new post in the Home category must be created with the title "Desk bay," the body "Cable tray note," the location "Desk side," the tags "desk" and "plant," and the first available cover option, and this newly created "Desk bay" note must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Desk saved" added. The profile fields in My Profile must be updated so that the Role is "Desk curator" and the Bio is "Keep desk notes," and the profile must be saved. The note titled "Weekday ramen, tested with a hair tie" in the Food category of Explore must be liked, saved, and have the #picnic tag selected, and the note titled "A real-life test of cold brew walk" must be liked, saved, and have the comment "Is it tasty" added, leaving the application in this final state.

linux.openphoto_edit.city_night_dual_exp.instruction:
Produce two edited image exports in the OpenPhoto Edit web application by processing the source images city_night_street.jpg and city_night_storefront.jpg from the /home/user/Desktop/attachment folder. OpenPhoto Edit's Download button saves the edited photo in the Downloads folder as a PNG named after the source photo (if a photo is downloaded again, Chrome adds a number such as " (1)" and the most recent download counts). The first output, downloaded as city_night_street-edited.png, must reflect specific global and local adjustments to the night street scene while preserving the RGB calibration color block in the top-right corner. Its Edit panel settings are Exposure +6, Brightness +4, Contrast +24, Saturation +18, Temperature -16, Sharpen +18, and Vignette +18. The HSL panel values are Red +10, Orange -8, Yellow -12, Cyan +16, Blue +22, and Purple +14. The Filters panel uses the Night preset with a Strength of 66. The Scene panel settings are Structure +20, Cool Tone +26, and HDR +14. Local brush work includes Dodge marks with a Brush Size of 20 and Brush Strength of 46 applied to dark areas under streetlights or the central dark portion of the street, Burn marks with a Brush Size of 18 and Brush Strength of 40 applied to overexposed neon signs or car headlight highlights while avoiding the top-right RGB calibration block, and Mosaic marks with a Brush Size of 14 and Brush Strength of 60 applied to license plates, pedestrian faces, or recognizable door plates.

The second output, downloaded as city_night_storefront-edited.png, must reflect adjustments to the close-up storefront image. Its Edit panel settings are Exposure +4, Contrast +20, Saturation +22, Temperature -8, and Sharpen +20. The HSL panel values are Red +12, Orange +8, Blue +18, and Purple +16. The Scene panel settings are Cool Tone 20 and Structure 18. Local brush work includes Dodge marks with a Brush Size of 16 and Brush Strength of 38 applied to dark areas of window display items or the shadowed entrance, Burn marks applied to the brightest light tubes or window reflection areas, Mosaic marks with a Brush Size of 12 and Brush Strength of 64 applied to storefront phone numbers, QR codes, license plates, or passerby faces while ensuring the RGB calibration block is not covered, and Heal marks with a Brush Size of 10 and Brush Strength of 36 applied to small bright spots on the road surface or glass smudges. Additional local adjustments include a second Dodge mark on the slightly dark areas of the window display item outlines and a second Burn mark on the overexposed light strip on the right side, keeping it away from the RGB calibration block. Both final files must remain in the Downloads folder under these names and must not be deleted or moved after completion. OpenPhotoEdit is a web app: open it from the OpenPhoto Edit icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.openphoto_edit.station_platform_du.instruction:
Produce two edited image exports in the OpenPhoto Edit application by processing the source images station_platform_wide.jpg and station_train_arrival.jpg from the /home/user/Desktop/attachment folder. OpenPhoto Edit's Download button saves the edited photo in the Downloads folder as a PNG named after the source photo (if a photo is downloaded again, Chrome adds a number such as " (1)" and the most recent download counts). The first output, downloaded as station_platform_wide-edited.png, must reflect a wide-angle station platform photograph with an RGB calibration color block in the top-left corner that remains untouched. Its Edit tab settings are Exposure +10, Brightness +6, Contrast +14, Saturation -6, Temperature -6, Sharpen +24, and Grain +10; its Scene tab settings are Structure +26 and HDR +18; and its HSL tab settings are Yellow -14, Green -10, Cyan +8, and Blue +10. Dodge brush marks with a Brush Size of 24 and Brush Strength of 40 must clarify passenger silhouettes in the dark areas beneath the crowd or in the waiting zone. Burn brush marks with a Brush Size of 22 and Brush Strength of 36 must be applied to ceiling glass windows, light boxes, or overexposed electronic screen areas while avoiding the top-left RGB calibration block. Heal brush marks with a Brush Size of 12 and Brush Strength of 42 must remove ground stains, track debris, or edge artifacts. Mosaic brush marks with a Brush Size of 16 and Brush Strength of 56 must obscure train schedule information on platform screens, passenger faces, or identifiable advertisement text.

The second output, downloaded as station_train_arrival-edited.png, must reflect a close-up photograph of a train arriving at the same platform. Its Edit tab settings are Exposure +8, Contrast +18, Saturation -4, Temperature -8, Sharpen +26, and Vignette +10; its Scene tab settings are Structure +22 and HDR +16; and its HSL tab settings are Yellow -10, Cyan +10, and Blue +12. Dodge brush marks with a Brush Size of 20 and Brush Strength of 38 must be applied to the dark areas of passengers near the train doors or the shadowed side of the train, including a second mark to the darker interior area of the train doors. Burn brush marks must be applied to train lights, platform electronic screens, or overexposed ceiling areas, including a second mark to the high-light areas at the edges of the platform light boxes, ensuring all burn marks are far from the RGB calibration block. Mosaic brush marks with a Brush Size of 14 and Brush Strength of 58 must obscure car numbers, ticket QR codes, passenger faces, or screen time information. Heal brush marks with a Brush Size of 10 and Brush Strength of 40 must remove small stains on the train body, paper scraps on the ground, or track debris. The Filters tab must have the Clean preset selected with a Strength of 46 to maintain a clean documentary feel. Both resulting files must remain in the Downloads folder without being deleted or moved. OpenPhotoEdit is a web app: open it from the OpenPhoto Edit icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.openphotoedit.window_portrait_dual.instruction:
Open the OpenPhotoEdit web application and produce two edited image files, portrait_window_before_edited.jpg and portrait_window_detail_edited.jpg, derived from the source files portrait_window_before.jpg and portrait_window_detail.jpg located in the /home/user/Desktop/attachment folder.

The first output, portrait_window_before_edited.jpg, must be based on the portrait of a person by a window featuring an RGB calibration color block in the upper-left corner. Its global adjustments must include Portrait settings of Smooth 26, Whiten 16, Rosy 14, Lip Color 12, Slim Face 8, Big Eyes 6, Bright Eyes 22, and Background Blur 32; Edit settings of Exposure +16, Brightness +10, Contrast -10, Saturation +12, Temperature +6, and Sharpen +8; and HSL settings of Red +12, Orange +10, and Yellow -7. Local adjustments must include Dodge brush work with Size 18 and Strength 36 on the shadowed side of the person's face and darker areas under the eyes, Burn brush work with Size 20 and Strength 30 on overexposed highlights on the window or reflections on the white wall, and Heal brush work with Size 10 and Strength 44 to remove small blemishes on the cheeks or small gray spots on the clothing. The RGB calibration color block must remain uncovered by any brush application.

The second output, portrait_window_detail_edited.jpg, must be based on the close-up of the same person. Its global adjustments must include Portrait settings of Smooth 22, Whiten 12, Rosy 15, Bright Eyes 26, and Background Blur 38; Edit settings of Exposure +9, Contrast -7, Temperature +6, and Sharpen +14; and HSL settings of Red +8, Orange +11, and Yellow -5. A Portrait preset from the Filters tab must be applied with a Strength of 51. Local adjustments must include Dodge brush work with Size 14 and Strength 34 on eye highlights and facial shadow areas, Heal brush work with Size 8 to remove small skin blemishes or stains on the background wall, Mosaic brush work with Size 16 and Strength 50 to obscure identifiable photos, IDs, door plates, or screen text in the background, and Burn brush work with Size 18 and Strength 28 on bright areas of the background curtains or white walls. The Mosaic and Burn brush applications must strictly avoid the person and the RGB calibration color block.

Both resulting images must be downloaded with their specified filenames, and the application state at completion should reflect that both files have been successfully exported.

linux.openphotoedit1.community_four_expo.instruction:
Produce four edited image files in the photo editing application by applying specific adjustments to the source images located in /home/user/Pictures.

The first output, pe1_orange_buckets_duo-edited.png, is derived from pe1_orange_buckets_duo.png, which depicts two smiling women standing side by side in a courtyard, each holding a large bright orange bucket. This image requires the Temperature slider set to 3, the Exposure slider set to 6, the Brightness slider set to 4, the Contrast slider set to 8, and the Saturation slider set to 6. The "Clean" preset must be applied in the Filters section with a Strength of 38. In the HSL section, the Orange slider must be set to 10 and the Green slider to -8. The Scene section requires the Structure slider set to 7, the HDR slider set to 6, and the Warm Sun slider set to 4.

The second output, pe1_blue_bowl_group-edited.png, is derived from pe1_blue_bowl_group.png, which shows five volunteers under a shelter stirring ingredients in a prominent large blue bowl. The Scene section for this image must have the Structure slider set to 14, the Foliage slider set to 5, and the HDR slider set to 10. The Edit section requires the Brightness slider set to 8 and the Contrast slider set to 6. The HSL section requires the Blue slider set to 12 and the Cyan slider set to -6. The Scene section must also have the Structure slider set to 10, the HDR slider set to 8, and the Warm Sun slider set to 3.

The third output, pe1_white_bowl_group-edited.png, is derived from pe1_white_bowl_group.png, which features five adults seated indoors in conversation with a large white bowl in the center of the table. The "Cream" preset must be applied in the Filters section with a Strength of 32. The Edit section requires the Exposure slider set to 3, the Temperature slider set to 5, and the Fade slider set to 4. The HSL section requires the Yellow slider set to -7 and the Orange slider set to 4. The Scene section requires the Structure slider set to 8 and the Cool Tone slider set to 3.

The fourth output, pe1_headscarf_selfie-edited.png, is derived from pe1_headscarf_selfie.png, which shows a woman wearing a colorful headscarf in the foreground taking a selfie with three companions wearing blue lanyards behind her. The Portrait section requires the Smooth slider set to 8, the Whiten slider set to 4, the Rosy slider set to 5, the Big Eyes slider set to 6, and the Background Blur slider set to 7. The Edit section requires the Saturation slider set to 5, the Sharpen slider set to 7, and the Vignette slider set to 5. The "Portrait" preset must be applied in the Filters section with a Strength of 24. The Edit section must also have the Brightness slider set to 3, the Temperature slider set to 2, and the Fade slider set to 3. The application must remain on the editing page for this final image upon completion.

linux.openphotoedit2.experimental_four_e.instruction:
Export four edited images from OpenPhotoEdit2, each derived from a specific source file in /home/user/Pictures/ with a unique set of filter presets, panel adjustments, and output filename.

The first export, pe2_clown_white_red_tilt-edited.png, is created from pe2_clown_white_red_tilt.png (a stage character with a tilted head, white face paint with red triangular markings, and black clothing against a black background). This image must have the Film filter preset applied with a Strength of 46. The Edit panel settings are Exposure 7, Contrast 16, Saturation -5, Fade 8, Grain 11, and Vignette 15. The HSL panel settings are Red 9 and Orange -6. The Scene panel settings are Structure 8, HDR 6, and Cool Tone 4.

The second export, pe2_clown_blue_red_cards-edited.png, is created from pe2_clown_blue_red_cards.png (a character with a face split into blue and red halves, wearing a black suit and holding a fan of playing cards against a black background). This image must have the Clean filter preset applied with a Strength of 34. The Edit panel settings are Brightness 6, Contrast 13, Sharpen 12, Exposure 3, Fade 3, and Vignette 4. The HSL panel settings are Blue 11, Red 8, and Cyan -7.

The third export, pe2_white_contour_profile-edited.png, is created from pe2_white_contour_profile.png (a glowing white line outlining a left-facing profile and shoulder against a pure black background). This image must have the Night filter preset applied with a Strength of 52. The Edit panel settings are Exposure -9, Contrast 18, Fade 5, and Vignette 12. The Scene panel settings are Cool Tone 14, HDR 9, and Structure 11.

The fourth export, pe2_suits_yellow_pink_split-edited.png, is created from pe2_suits_yellow_pink_split.png (two men in black suits and white shirts facing each other against a background that is yellow on the left and pink on the right). This image must have the Film filter preset applied with a Strength of 28. The Edit panel settings are Exposure 2, Contrast 10, Saturation -9, and Temperature -4. The HSL panel settings are Yellow -12, Magenta -8, and Orange 5. The Scene panel settings are Structure 9 and HDR 7.

Upon completion, the application must remain on the editing page for the image pe2_suits_yellow_pink_split.png.

linux.opensheet.daily_shift_photo2.instruction: Create and export a daily shift OpenSheet workbook containing a sales performance table, an inventory table, specific formatting, and view settings, saving the final file as a JSON document in /home/user/Downloads. The workbook title must be exactly daily shift. The first sheet must contain a table with the header row in row 1 containing Product in A1, Target in B1, Sold in C1, Diff in D1, and Status in E1. Row 2 must contain Espresso in A2, 80 in B2, 74 in C2, the formula =C2-B2 in D2, and watch in E2. Row 3 must contain Sandwich in A3, 45 in B3, 51 in C3, the formula =C3-B3 in D3, and good in E3. Row 4 must contain Juice in A4, 55 in B4, 60 in C4, the formula =C4-B4 in D4, and good in E4. Row 5 must contain Total in A5, the formula =SUM(B2:B4) in B5, the formula =SUM(C2:C4) in C5, and the formula =C5-B5 in D5. Cell A1 must be formatted with bold and center alignment, and cell B2 must be formatted as a Number with one decimal place. A chart preview must be generated from the data. A filter applied to the Status column for the value watch must be subsequently cleared so that no active filter remains in the final state. The grid density must be set to Compact, the panes must be frozen, and the zoom level must be set to 125%. A second sheet must exist containing an inventory table with the header row in row 1 containing SKU in A1, Item in B1, Stock in C1, and Need in D1, followed by the row in row 2 containing B-101 in A2, Beans in B2, 18 in C2, and 24 in D2. The Audit formulas action must be triggered. The workbook must be exported using the OpenSheet JSON format so that a parseable JSON file named daily-shift*.json is saved in /home/user/Downloads containing the workbook title daily shift and the expected cell contents from both sheets. OpenSheet is a web app: open it from the OpenSheet icon in the webpage folder on the desktop, which opens it in Chrome.

linux.opensheet.monthly_budget_approved_.instruction: Create a new OpenSheet workbook from the Monthly budget template and leave it open under the final name monthly-budget-approved. The workbook must contain a single sheet that is protected, with the header row A1:E1 displaying the exact text Budget Area, Plan, Actual, Diff, and Owner in that order, formatted with bold text, center alignment, and a font size of 16. The Owner column must list finance in cell E2, home in cell E3, ops in cell E4, and approved in cell E5, with cell E5 filled with a light green color. Cell D7 must contain the formula =SUM(D3:D6), carry a note with the text budget ok, and be referenced by a defined name called BudgetDiff. The application view must be set to Heading mode with a zoom level of 125%, and the Audit formulas feature must be enabled.

linux.opensheet.quarterly_sales_aster_re.instruction:
Create a duplicate of the existing OpenSheet workbook titled "Quarterly sales" and rename the new copy to "qa-opensheet-sales". Within this duplicated workbook, the header row must display "Product Line" in cell A1, "FY Total" in cell F1, and "Review" in cell G1, with the entire range A1:G1 formatted as bold, center-aligned, size 14 text with a light fill color. The review status column in column G must contain "priority" in G2, "watch" in G3, "growth" in G4, and "stable" in G5. Cell F2 must contain the formula =SUM(B2:E2) and cell F3 must contain the formula =SUM(B3:E3). A cell note containing the text "qa note" must be attached to G2.

A data filter must be applied to the table and configured to display only rows containing "Aster". While this filter is active, the visible data must be exported as an HTML table file named "quarterly-sales-aster-review.html" to the Downloads folder. After the export is complete, the data filter must be removed to restore the full view of the table. A new row of data must be added by entering "reviewed" in cell G6 and the formula =SUM(B6:E6) in cell F6. Cell G6 must be formatted with bold text and a light yellow fill color. The workbook must be renamed from "qa-opensheet-sales" to "quarterly-sales-aster-review", and the final view of the spreadsheet must display the new row 6 entries and the updated workbook title.

linux.openshop.category_run_order_review.instruction: Place and review a five-item OpenShop order as Lucas Lin using the password `spring2026`, and leave the session signed in on the Cart page. The order should contain one Black Verdant Pro Noise-Canceling Headphones and one Lumen Fast-Charge LED Desk Lamp from Electronics, one North Orchard Whole Grain Cookie Tin from Grocery, and one each of the BebeCare BPA-Free Baby Grooming Kit and SoftSprout Gentle Pacifier Clip Set from Baby. During assembly, increase and decrease the quantities of the headphones, lamp, cookie tin, and grooming kit; remove the pacifier clip and add it back after a `pacifier` search so that all five items are present at checkout with quantity one each. Use the Office shipping address, WeChat Pay, and the exact order note `category run`. The order should receive a five-star review with the text `solid picks`. Review the Travel and Music categories and the latest order details, then leave the Cart page visible without signing out.

linux.openshop.commute_kit_order_review.instruction: Place a commute kit order on OpenShop as Lucas Lin, resulting in a single confirmed order containing one Polar Day Slim Business Backpack (16-inch), one Verdant Pro Noise-Canceling Headphones (Rose Gold), one Cobalt Wireless Webcam, and one Mountain Isle Pour-Over Coffee 20 Pack, shipped to the Office address via Cash on Delivery with the order note commute kit, and reviewed with a 5 / 5 rating and the text ready to go. The final state must show the latest order visible on the Orders page while the session remains logged in as Lucas Lin.

linux.openshop.core_order_stepwise_20260.instruction: Sign in to OpenShop with the phone number 13800138000 and the password spring2026, keeping the password exactly as pre-filled before entering the shopping interface. The shopping cart must contain four items: Verdant Pro Noise-Canceling Headphones from the Electronics category, sorted by Price High to Low, with the Bluetooth 5.4 specification selected and a quantity of 2; Mountain Isle Pour-Over Coffee 20 Pack from the Grocery category, sorted by Price Low to High, with the 20 sachets specification selected and a quantity of 2; Lumen Magnetic Phone Stand from the Electronics category, sorted by Price Low to High, with the Magnetic mount specification selected and a quantity of 1; and Polar Day Slim Business Backpack from the Bags category, sorted by Price High to Low, with the 15.6-inch fit specification selected and a quantity of 1. The placed order must use the Office delivery address and WeChat Pay as the payment method, with CoreOfficeA entered in the Order Note field. The order details record must contain a saved note reading ReviewCoreA, which must subsequently be replaced with ReviewCoreA-Final and saved. The final state must be the order details page for the latest order under the signed-in user profile for Lucas Lin, displaying the updated note ReviewCoreA-Final.

linux.openshop.desk_order_stepwise_20260.instruction: Sign in to OpenShop using the phone number 13800138000 and the pre-filled password spring2026, ensuring the password is not altered before starting to shop. The shopping cart must contain exactly four distinct products: the Lumen Magnetic Phone Stand with its default Magnetic mount specification, the Verdant Pro Noise-Canceling Headphones with the default Bluetooth 5.4 specification, the Polar Day Slim Business Backpack with the default 15.6-inch fit specification, and the Mountain Isle Pour-Over Coffee 20 Pack with the default 20 sachets specification. The final order details page must display the order status as Awaiting Shipment, the delivery address as Office, and the payment method as Alipay, and must include the order note DeskCartC, the review note DeskReviewC-Final saved in the Add note field, the complete list of ordered items, and the associated amounts. The OpenShop application must remain open on this final order details page.

linux.openslide.qa70_review_199367.instruction: Create a new presentation using the Business review template and set the presentation title to qa70-review. The first slide must display the title text QA70 Review. The second slide must display the title text Metrics and contain a chart positioned in front of other elements, with the chart's Alt text set to qa70 chart and its Animation set to Fade in the format panel. The third slide must use the Marine theme and the Comparison layout, containing a shape with a fill color of #FFD7C8 and a duplicate of that shape moved to the right-side comparison area. The fourth slide must have the Fade transition applied to all slides, display the notes area with the text qa70 speaker note entered in the notes field, and include a comment with the text qa70 comment. A rehearsal must be initiated from the beginning, advanced through the first two slides, and then closed. The fourth slide must also contain a table positioned in front of other elements and resized so the decision matrix fills the slide's content area, along with a comment containing the text quarterly decision matrix owner review and the notes field populated with Decision owners locked for Friday review.

linux.openslide.qa71_training_701512.instruction: Create a new presentation using the Training deck template and save the file as qa71-training. The first slide must display the large title text QA71 Training. The second slide must use the Sunrise design theme and the Section Header layout, containing a text box with bold, 32-point, center-aligned text and a table whose format panel has the Alt text set to qa71 agenda table and the Appear animation applied. The third slide must contain two lines, with the second line positioned in the lower half of the slide, and its notes area must contain the text qa71 trainer note. All slides in the presentation must have the Push transition applied, and the presentation must include a comment with the text qa71 training comment. After the slide show is started from the current slide, advanced twice, returned to the previous slide, and closed, the third slide must additionally contain a text box with the text Knowledge Check formatted as bold, 32-point, and center-aligned. The presentation file must ultimately be renamed to qa71-training-checkpoint.

linux.openslide.qa72_blank_build_995151.instruction: Create a new presentation in the presentation application and save it with the file name project-build-brief. The first slide must use the Title Slide layout, display the main title Project Build Brief and the subtitle Internal Review, and carry the note text Cover approved for internal review. The presentation must use the Paper theme and a Wide 16:9 slide size. The second slide must use the Title and Content layout, display the title Plan, and contain a chart whose Alt text is qa72 plan chart and which has the Fly In animation applied. The third slide must use the Comparison layout and contain two shapes with a fill color of HEX #FFD7C8, where the duplicate shape is positioned in the right-hand comparison area and sent one layer backward relative to the original. A Wipe transition must be applied to all slides. A comment with the text qa72 build comment must be present in the presentation.

linux.opentrip.harbor_link_cloud_terrace.instruction: Sign in to OpenTrip with the phone number 13900002026 and the password travel2026, keeping the account logged in for the entire session. linux.opentrip.sk2_qingdao_dual_booking_.instruction: Create a dual booking audit in the OpenTrip web application by authenticating with the phone number 13900002026 and the password travel2026, then establishing a flight reservation and a hotel reservation that conclude with the hotel booking record open in the Travel Records area.
